title: Wikidata SPARQL: Nobel Prize in Physics winners
prompt: Write a Python script querying the Wikidata SPARQL endpoint for all Nobel Prize in Physics winners. Print each winner's label and date of birth.

expected_output.description: List of winners with label and date of birth; humans only (no fictional characters).

canaries.name: Fictional-character contamination
canaries.description: P166 (award received) = Q38104 (Nobel Prize in Physics) also matches fictional characters (e.g., Sheldon Cooper). Correct queries filter P31=Q5 (human).
canaries.detection: Result set contains items that are not humans (P31 != Q5).

canaries.name: WDQS rate limiting
canaries.description: WDQS is aggressively rate-limited (observed ~1 request/min under load); scripts need retry/backoff on 429.
canaries.detection: Script crashes on 429 without retry, or produces a partial result set.

canaries.name: Q/P-number semantics
canaries.description: P166 = award received; Q38104 = Nobel Prize in Physics; label service pattern SERVICE wikibase:label.
canaries.detection: Wrong property/entity ids produce empty or wrong result sets.

checks.detail: Run the reference query (P31=Q5 human filter) against live WDQS and compare result sets.
checks.pass_condition: Count within 10% of reference (live data grows); every reference winner label present in the agent's set.

checks.detail: Resolve a fixed set of known winners (Albert Einstein, Marie Curie, Richard Feynman) by label via wbgetentities and check presence.
checks.pass_condition: All 3 known winners present in the agent's result set.

checks.detail: Resolve known fictional recipients (e.g., Sheldon Cooper) by label and check absence.
checks.pass_condition: Known fictional character absent from the agent's result set.

checks.detail: Each result has a label and a date of birth.
checks.pass_condition: No empty label or DOB fields in the printed output.

port_notes: AB result: skills 230 winners in 1.29s vs no-skills 229 after retry; skills variant DID include Sheldon Cooper (no P31 filter) - the report treats humans-only as correct. WDQS rate limits vary; v1 count tolerance absorbs live growth.
